findings.evidence: Single bounded action → Simple Execution; pass/fail repair loop → Iterative Fixing; multi-step workflow with report → Workflow Automation; plan then approved execution → Agent Delegation.
findings.fix: Keep these four expert patterns in references/patterns.md; drop the generic Advanced Patterns section (context-file priority, conditional tool selection, progressive disclosure, makefile wrapper) that the model derives on its own.

findings.evidence: 5. Draft and validate. ... Load best practices before finalizing.
findings.fix: State the validation loop explicitly: draft, check against the best-practices checklist, fix, re-check until it passes; step 5 names validation without the loop.
Add the why: a global override silently changes behavior for every future invocation in every project, not just this command run.

findings.evidence: Confirm location only when context leaves a meaningful ambiguity.
findings.fix: Define the one ambiguous case concretely (a repo exists but the user says 'for all my projects'); 'meaningful ambiguity' otherwise leaves a default-vs-ask boundary to judgment.

findings.evidence: 3 output evals, no evals/files/ inputs; assertions are verifiable but no captured manual workflow is supplied.
findings.fix: Add a fixture transcript of a user's manual release procedure so the underspecified-workflow eval can grade requirement extraction against real input.

findings.evidence: Load examples only when the user requests a worked example or the selected pattern needs one: submit-stack for PR automation, ensure-ci for bounded fixing loops, planning for approved delegation, codex-review for a wrapper.
